bugs.title: Credit Note editor does not support return or adjustment reason logging
steps: Sign in to Nexstock QA Company and open Credit Notes > Create Credit Note.
Select QA Billing Automation Customer and add a product line.
Look for a return reason or adjustment type such as Product return, Billing correction or Price concession.
Save an invoice-linked QA credit and reopen its detail.
bugs.expected: A user can record the return/adjustment reason and see it retained with the credit note.
bugs.actual: There is no reason input or reason selection in the editor. The save payload sends reason and reasonCode as empty strings; the saved QA credit retains an empty reason.
bugs.comment: Add a reason field/type, preserve it in the saved record and show it on the official voucher/history. This ticket covers the missing capability rather than inventing mandatory validation or reason-code policy.

bugs.title: Credit Note has no optional return-to-stock or warehouse selection
steps: Open Credit Notes > Create Credit Note in the QA company.
Select a QA customer and an inventory product line.
Inspect all creation controls for return-to-stock and receiving warehouse options.
Inspect the saved credit's available actions.
bugs.expected: A product return can optionally restock the selected warehouse; leaving the option off should preserve stock.
bugs.actual: Creation has customer, linked invoice, dates, product/quantity/price and discount controls, but no restock toggle or warehouse selector. Saved detail offers printing only.
bugs.comment: Implement the optional restock workflow and preserve location/quantity linkage. Retest both enabled/disabled cases and branch isolation; no stock effect is claimed passed from this missing-UI check.

bugs.title: Saved invoice-linked credit has no allocation or cash-refund action
steps: Create an isolated paid Rs 100 QA invoice for QA Billing Automation Customer.
Create a Rs 100 Credit Note linked to that exact invoice using the available Save as Draft action.
Confirm the saved record exists with status open and remaining balance Rs 100.
Open its eye/View action and inspect available controls.
bugs.expected: The available credit can be applied through an invoice allocation workflow or settled as an explicitly recorded cash refund.
bugs.actual: The saved detail exposes Print and PDF only. There is no apply-credit, allocation, activation/issue transition or cash-refund action, leaving the recorded Rs 100 credit inaccessible for settlement.
bugs.comment: Add the credit lifecycle and allocation/refund controls with balance updates and audit linkage. Saved open credit was observed; do not assume money moved or log a separate cash-refund processing defect without an accessible action.
